_comment: Copy to config.json (scripts/install-pi.sh does this for you). Every key is optional; LABHUB_<KEY> env vars override. github_repo is the separate DATA repo that holds board.json, not the code repo lab-hub. pages_url is the Pages site (published from the code repo) with ?repo= so new browsers pre-fill the data repo. Keep host/port here, not in /etc/default/lab-hub. Prefer the LABHUB_GITHUB_TOKEN env var (or install-pi.sh, which chmods config.json to 600) over typing the token here. See README.md > Configuration.
name: Lab Hub
